title: SlottedBaselineSet (internal diagnostic shape)
description: In-memory per-session slotted baseline set — never serialised to the LLM. This schema documents the logical structure for testing and explainability.

horizons.description: Active look-back horizons in days, e.g. [7, 30]

min_samples.description: Minimum bucket sample count for a bucket to be considered reliable

flat_anchors.description: Fallback flat signal anchors keyed by signal name
